sentences.text: This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the BNSS 2023 for grant of bail.

The applicant has been arrested on 31.07.2025 in connection with Crime No.186/2025 registered at Police Station Porsa, District Morena (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 376, 506, 386, 34 of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act and 66E, 67A, 67B of I.T. Act.
2.

According to the prosecution story, that the prosecutrix submitted a typewritten application to the Police Station Porsa regarding the report of raping her and threatening her by making a video to the effect that she had known Shivam Tomar about four years ago in June 2021.
Shivam Tomar called her from near a saree shop on Durgpura Road and he gave her a cold drink.
After taking a cold drink, she started feeling dizzyness.
He called Vishwajeet (applicant) and he had taken the prosecutrix in his bike with NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:20320 2 MCRC-37074-2025 Shivam Tomar and Shivam committed rape with her.
Therefore, the aforesaid offence was registered.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.
Applicant is in custody since 31.07.2025.
Investigation is almost complete.
The applicant has not committed any rape.
The applicant was accompanied by the co-accused Shivam on his bike.
The main accused is Shivam Tomar.
The FIR was lodged after four years.
The applicant is ready to abide by all the conditions that may be imposed by this Court.

Under these circumstances,
counsel for the applicant prays for grant of bail.

sentences.text: 4. Per contra, learned State counsel vehemently opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
6.

Considering the above submissions advanced by learned counsel for the parties and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) along with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court.
7.
Certified copy as per rules.
